title: RippleGuard Impact Ledger
description: Evidence-linked blast radius for one change ticket. Written by the rippleguard-analyze Bob skill; statuses advanced by rippleguard-implement; audited by rippleguard-verify; enforced by scripts/ripple-gate.js.

generated_by.description: Which Bob task/skill produced or last updated this ledger.
